intro: Review what you've learned about tests and feedback speed.

questions.prompt: What main benefit does an automated test provide?

options.text: It automatically covers every possible edge case.
It reduces future refactoring by locking the system's design.
It tells you whether the system behaves as intended.
It guarantees that every future feature will be easier to build, regardless of complexity.

questions.prompt: Why use integration and end-to-end tests when unit tests score highest in maintainability and feedback speed?

options.text: High-level tests become faster than unit tests as a system grows.
Unit tests alone do not verify that all parts work together.
Integration and E2E tests automatically document the system's architecture.
Unit tests become obsolete once a project has integration tests.
